title: Trip to Yogyakarta
body:
# Trip to Yogyakarta

Things to **book** before leaving:

- Train tickets (Gambir → Tugu)
- Hotel near *Malioboro*
- Borobudur sunrise tour

> Pack light, buy batik there.

See `itinerary.md` for the day plan.
